title: onboard-lucent-13b-v1.0-performance-profiles-and-changelog-automation
author: Sophia Chen
description: Onboard Lucent-13B v1.0 into the model registry with performance profiles, metadata, and automated changelog/release-note generation. Motivation: Lucent-13B is expected to be a reliable mid-size model for conversational and code-assist workloads; adding it to the registry unlocks serving & routing policies and lets Optimize suggest quantization profiles. This PR includes: (1) model metadata (architecture, tokenizer, hf-id, sha512 of artifacts), (2) calibrated performance profiles for common sequence-length buckets (128/512/2048) on a range of GPU types, (3) changelog/release-notes automation templates and a CI step that emits a consolidated release note fragment when profiles or metadata change, and (4) docs and quickstart snippets. Checklist: - [x] Add model metadata JSON and basic validation schema - [x] Run perf harness and generate profiles for A100 (80GB), A10G, and T4 baselines - [x] Add automated changelog fragment generation step in model-registry CI - [x] Update docs/quickstarts and changelog template - [x] Add unit tests for metadata validator and profile parser - [x] Obtain perf review from @Omar and API compatibility check from @Helen Notes: perf numbers are calibrated with the perf-harness using representative prompt suites; the profiles include p50/p95 token latency and throughput estimates for batch sizes 1/8/32. The changelog automation produces a markdown fragment (models/CHANGELOG/fragments/lucent-13b-v1.0.md) that will be assembled into the public release notes by the release job. See linked Linear tasks for rollout plan and QA matrices.
